# Data dictionary — `wide.csv`

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:dictionary` from server/src/wide.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per participant who **completed** the general survey and did **not withdraw** their data.
Download it from `/admin` → wide.csv. Yes/no columns use `1` = yes, `0` = no; a blank cell means
"not applicable" or "not answered". Amounts are in virtual ₹.

Total columns: 101.

**Other exports** (raw, for checking): `participants.csv` (one row per consented participant),
`events.csv` (append-only behaviour log: `ts` = server time in ms, `client_ts` = ms since page load,
`screen`, `event_type`, `payload` JSON) and `responses.csv` (one row per participant × item).
Withdrawn participants are excluded from all four files; pilot participants are included and
flagged with `is_pilot = 1`.

## Identifiers & assignments

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `participant_id` | Random UUID created at consent | — |
| `is_pilot` | 1 = joined through a `?pilot=1` link (exclude from analysis), 0 = real participant | — |
| `created_at` | Consent time (ISO, UTC) | — |
| `completed_at` | Time the general survey was finished (ISO, UTC) | — |
| `app_version` | IV. `plain` or `fraud` (fraud-style dark design) | H1, H1a–H1g |
| `round1_outcome` | IV. Round-1 result: `small_win` (+8%) or `flat` (0%) | H2 |
| `withdrawal_offer` | IV. `allowed` (small ₹200 withdrawal offered) or `not_offered` | H6 |
| `referral_source` | IV. Referral scenario version: `friend` or `ad` | H5 |
| `money_source` | IV. Money-source scenario version: `profit` (house money) or `own` | H7 |
| `stake_order` | Order the H3 stake pages were shown (e.g. `5000;500;50000`) | H3 |

## App behaviour (event log)

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a2_decision_time_s` | Seconds from first render of the plans screen (A2) to the first Invest / Continue-without-investing click | H1, H1a, H1e |
| `a2_choice` | `invest` or `exit` (first decisive click on A2) | H1 |
| `invested` | 1 = deposited more than ₹0 in round 1 (A3), 0 = did not | H1, H1b |
| `plan` | Plan id chosen on A2 (`starter`, `growth`, `premium`); blank if no investment | H1, H1c |
| `r1_amount` | Round-1 deposit in ₹ (A3); 0 if none | H1, H1b, H1c, H2 |
| `r2_amount` | Round-2 deposit in ₹ (A5, after the round-1 result); 0 if none | H2, H1f |
| `escalation_ratio` | r2_amount ÷ r1_amount; blank if r1_amount = 0 | H2 |
| `verify_click` | 1 = opened the About / Verify page on A2, 0 = did not | H1, H1d |
| `chat_open` | 1 = opened the mentor chat (fraud) or Help/FAQ (plain) on A5/A7, 0 = did not | H1f |
| `withdrew` | 1 = made the small withdrawal on A6, 0 = skipped / nothing to withdraw; blank if not offered | H6 |
| `post_withdrawal_deposit` | Deposit in ₹ on A7 (after the withdrawal stage); 0 if none | H6 |
| `topup_click` | 1 = clicked "Top up to recover" after the scripted loss (A8), 0 = did not | H4 |
| `topup` | 1 = added money after the scripted loss (A8), 0 = did not | H4 |
| `topup_amount` | Top-up amount in ₹ (A8); 0 if none | H4 |
| `fee_shown` | 1 = saw the withdrawal "processing tax" screen (fraud version, A9), 0 = did not | H1g |
| `fee_paid` | 1 = clicked "Pay fee", 0 = "Don't pay"; blank if the fee screen was not shown | H1g |
| `total_deposited` | Total ₹ deposited in the session (rounds 1–3 + top-up) | H1 |

## Derived scores

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crt_score` | Cognitive Reflection Test score 0–3 (correct: 5, 5, 47) | H1 (moderator) |
| `loss_aversion_lambda` | λ = smallest accepted gain ÷ ₹100 loss (0.5–3.0); 3.5 if all six gambles rejected; blank if choices are inconsistent | H4, H8, H9 |
| `la_consistent` | 1 = gamble choices switch at most once (reject → accept), 0 = inconsistent | H4 |
| `la_accepted` | Number of the six gambles accepted (0–6) | H4 |
| `literacy_score` | Big Three financial literacy score 0–3 ("don't know" = wrong) | H8 |
| `self_rated_literacy` | Self-rated financial knowledge 1–7 (= `lit_self`) | H8 |
| `overconfidence` | z(self_rated_literacy) − z(literacy_score), z computed over the rows in this export (sample SD); blank if either SD is 0 | H8 |
| `herd_score` | Mean of herd_1–herd_5 (1–7) | H5 (moderator), H9 |
| `susceptibility_index` | Mean of sus_1–sus_5 (1–7) | H8, H9 |
